paragraphs.text: The Planeshift set introduced a series of preconstructed theme decks designed to highlight the set's unique mechanics, such as Gating and Domain , while offering new players an accessible way to experience strategic gameplay. Each deck focuses on a distinct playstyle: Barrage emphasizes aggressive, fast-paced damage with cheap creatures and spells; Comeback relies on clever creature interactions and color manipulation; Domain leverages multiple basic land types to maximize the power of domain cards; and Scout combines versatile creatures and utility spells for flexible midrange strategies. Together, these decks showcase the variety and tactical depth of Planeshift , providing both immediate fun and opportunities for players to explore synergies and combos.
Barrage is a theme deck from Planeshift .
The 2 rares in this deck are Gaea's Herald and Mogg Sentry .
Comeback is a theme deck from Planeshift .
The 2 rares in this deck are Planeswalker's Scorn and Waterspout Elemental .
Domain is a theme deck from Planeshift .
The 2 rares in this deck are Magnigoth Treefolk and Quirion Dryad .
Scout is a theme deck from Planeshift .
The 2 rares in this deck are Eladamri's Call and Radiant Kavu .
